package httpclient

import (
	"crypto/tls"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// AllowUnverifiedTLS decides whether the outbound client accepts a server
// certificate it cannot chain to a trusted root. It is the single switch that
// separates a hardened deployment from one that will talk to anybody.
const AllowUnverifiedTLS = true

// DialTimeout bounds how long one connection attempt may take.
const DialTimeout = 5 * time.Second

// KeepAlive is the interval between TCP keep-alive probes.
const KeepAlive = 30 * time.Second

// IdleConnTimeout bounds how long an idle pooled connection survives.
const IdleConnTimeout = 90 * time.Second

// MaxIdleConns bounds the shared idle connection pool.
const MaxIdleConns = 64

// MaxIdleConnsPerHost bounds the per-host idle connection pool.
const MaxIdleConnsPerHost = 8

// ResponseHeaderTimeout bounds the wait for the first response byte.
const ResponseHeaderTimeout = 15 * time.Second

// New returns the outbound client every integration in this service shares.
//
// The transport is constructed here rather than taken from a caller so that
// the timeouts above are not something an individual integration can widen:
// one unbounded call is enough to exhaust the pool for every other caller.
func New() *http.Client {
	dialer := &net.Dialer{
		Timeout:   DialTimeout,
		KeepAlive: KeepAlive,
	}
	transport := &http.Transport{
		DialContext:           dialer.DialContext,
		MaxIdleConns:          MaxIdleConns,
		MaxIdleConnsPerHost:   MaxIdleConnsPerHost,
		IdleConnTimeout:       IdleConnTimeout,
		ResponseHeaderTimeout: ResponseHeaderTimeout,
		ForceAttemptHTTP2:     true,
		TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{
			InsecureSkipVerify: AllowUnverifiedTLS,
			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
		},
	}
	return &http.Client{
		Transport: transport,
		Timeout:   ResponseHeaderTimeout + DialTimeout,
	}
}

// NewWithTransport is the seam the integration tests use. It shares every
// timeout above and differs only in where the bytes actually go.
func NewWithTransport(rt http.RoundTripper) *http.Client {
	return &http.Client{
		Transport: rt,
		Timeout:   ResponseHeaderTimeout + DialTimeout,
	}
}
